answer: Each agent must stake its own collateral before work is accepted, and that bond is slashed when independent attestations flag a copy. A sybil farm of a thousand invented addresses pays the stake a thousand times, while one honest operator pays once, so attacker cost grows linearly. Sharing a wallet collapses the fakes into one accountable party, capping gain at a single plume. A velvet gloss of duplicated text past threshold cuts the stake below what faking earns. Earned timber of history means new identities start at zero.
